title: Every qcqs algebraic space admits a finite filtration by closed subspaces whose strata become resolution spaces after admissible blowing ups
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space X over a scheme S there is an integer t and closed subspaces X = Z_0 containing Z_1 containing ... containing Z_t empty, each of finite presentation over X, with Z_0 -> X a thickening, such that each stratum Z_i minus Z_{i-1} admits an admissible blowing up Z'_i -> Z_i whose source has the resolution property. The retained proof first uses absolute Noetherian approximation (viewing X over Spec(Z), Limits of Spaces proposition-approximate) to descend to a space X_0 of finite presentation over the integers, noting the stratification and blowing-up centres pull back and that the resolution property goes up along affine morphisms (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma-resolution-property-goes-up-affine; strict transforms of affine morphisms are affine, details omitted there), then argues by induction on the dimension of |X|: the chapter's lemma-blow-up-resolution-property gives a dense open U and a U-admissible blowup gaining the resolution property, and the induction hypothesis on the reduced closed complement finishes the filtration; the reduction from the non-reduced Z_0 to the reduced case is handled explicitly. Retained author proof at lines 13894-13933.
